# Categorize Transactions

`GRADED` `PROPOSES-WRITES` `EVIDENCE-GATED` `HUMAN-APPROVAL` `MATERIALITY-AWARE` `DETERMINISTIC-MATH` `POLICY-CAPTURING`

Clears uncategorized buckets using the client's own COA rules — never guesses. Every proposal carries a one-word basis (rule / history / unsure), and an "unsure" left uncategorized is the correct outcome.

## Why these badges

- **`PROPOSES-WRITES`** — Applies categorizations only after batch confirmation; without the write capability it emits a CSV for manual import.
- **`EVIDENCE-GATED`** — Stops entirely if no COA.md exists — categorizing without rules is guessing.
- **`DETERMINISTIC-MATH`** — Counts and totals computed by awk/python3 over the CSV, never mental math.

## Inputs

| Input | Required | Where it comes from | If it's missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `transactions.list-uncategorized` | **yes** | integration manifest | CSV export of uncategorized transactions |
| `COA.md` | **yes** | client workspace | none — stops and suggests /onboard-client |
| `accounts.list-chart` | no | integration manifest | rely on COA.md alone |
| `MATERIALITY.md` | no | client workspace | no uncategorized-at-close threshold applied |

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Where it lands |
|---|---|---|
| applied categorizations | ledger writes | accounting system — confirmed batches only, then re-queried to verify the bucket shrank by exactly the applied count |
| categorization-&lt;period&gt;.csv | csv | client workspace — txn id, date, payee, amount, target account (when no write capability) |
| new rules | markdown | COA.md — written inline as overrides reveal them, not batched |
| tie-check | chat | count + total categorized by account; count + total still uncategorized vs threshold |

## What it will not do

- Propose a category on vibes when no rule and no history exist.
